body: Mas precise ang official rationale kaysa simpleng ‘processing-cost recovery.’ FACT: sabi mismo ng ISA Q&A, isinama sa fee-setting ang direct examination cost, broader immigration-management spending, comparable foreign-country fees, at future inflation; duration-based pricing is justified partly by differing ‘benefit’ from longer stays. Ibig sabihin, hindi ito pure user-fee accounting. Mara take: hanggang walang published per-application cost bridge, huwag i-present ang 20x PR fee jump na mechanically derived from actual processing expense.

sources.title: 令和８年１０月１日付け在留許可手数料の額の改定等に関するQ&A

claims.text: ISA says the fee ceilings considered direct examination costs, broader costs of immigration/residence administration, comparable foreign fees, and future inflation; it also says duration-based fees reflect differing benefit from the permitted stay length.
The official rationale therefore does not establish that the new fee schedule is a direct pass-through of per-application processing cost.
claims.basis: The Q&A lists multiple non-processing-cost factors and does not publish a per-application cost bridge.
